label: preparing
what: There are two distinct activities evidenced. The bakery group has been discussing a rumored bridge or port change, but no concrete plan or confirmed change is established, so the participants' role in any actual preparation is uncertain. Separately, the builder and innkeeper arranged an informal 17:30 gathering/escort before the scheduled great-hall lantern inspection; the secretary knowingly attends and helps record/coordinate it. This is for inspecting the eight installed lanterns, not a secret civic project, and the mayor was informed and approved the inspection.
